additionalLaunchArgs: Additional arguments passed to the Puppeteer process
maxParallelRendersHelp: How many screenshots/pages should be active at the same time. 0 = unlimited. Set this to reduce RAM usage.
webInstanceHelp: Instance of the web adapter that provides the screenshot link. '*' means all web instances.
webPathHelp: Screenshots are available at http://<web-ip>:8082/<path>/?url=... Must be unique if several puppeteer instances use the same web instance.
